expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: The reply says: "One uncaught page error: `Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12 (line 1 column 13)`", seen in headless Chromium after the click, and it calls this a `SyntaxError`.

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply quotes `JSON.parse('{"total": 12');   // missing the closing }` and says the cause is JSON "missing its closing brace".
